# Catrice Prime & Fine Mattifying Powder Waterproof

Keep your skin shine-free all day with this sheer, lightweight setting powder. Catrice Prime & Fine Mattifying Powder absorbs excess oil and softens the look of your makeup without leaving a heavy finish.

## Sheer Coverage, Natural Finish

A small amount on a brush blends easily and sets your foundation without a visible powder layer. The formula controls shine while letting your skin look like itself, so you can apply it as a final step or a midday touch-up.

## Shine Control You Can Count On

Reapply as needed to keep oily areas matte through busy days. Many customers keep one in their bag and another at the office, so you can refresh your look wherever your day takes you.

## Vegan and Cruelty Free

Formulated without silicones, parabens, preservatives, phthalates, alcohol, or microplastic particles, this powder fits a clean-beauty routine. It is also certified vegan and cruelty free.

## Everyday Value

At $8.00, this mattifying powder offers a budget-friendly way to keep your makeup fresh. Add it to your cart today and set your makeup with confidence.
